system.description: Starting at 6th level, you passively convert your chakra into your barriers hit points far more efficiently. When you would use a maneuver, your Chakra Shield regains hit points equal to the highest dice result rolled as part of the maneuvers effect. If the maneuver doesn’t roll dice, then roll 1 superiority die, using that as the result.
